others.name: UDiverse Limited
others.role: Controlling shareholder; also holds 2500000 Class B shares

what: It offers web hosting, cybersecurity, blockchain and domain services from Hong Kong.
proceeds: It expects about $30.2 million at the $6.00 midpoint price. About 30% is for blockchain marketing and AI content tools, 30% to automate cybersecurity checks and move to subscriptions, and 40% for working capital and general needs.
risks: China's government could step in and influence the Hong Kong business, which could greatly change its operations and the value of the shares.
Meeting Hong Kong's personal data privacy law and similar future rules could cost a lot and hurt the business.
The Hong Kong National Security Law could affect the Hong Kong subsidiary, which makes up nearly all of the business.
Political risks come with doing business in Hong Kong.
The business earns Hong Kong dollars while the shares are priced in US dollars, so exchange rate changes may affect the value of your investment.
